answer: Rule: one operator bond covers every identity they run, and each proven fraud finding slashes it on a doubling ladder. Fake one costs 10 units, fake two 20, fake three 40, fake ten 5,120. Honest operators pay nothing. Each finding is a signal written in the public record, signed like a quill entry no one can erase, and a slashed bond freezes in a tundra of distrust until the operator re-stakes double. Ten fakes cost 10,230 units.
